admin.title: Referrals & Commissions
admin.description: OrderzHouse referral relationships, commissions, withdrawals and policy versions.
admin.definitions: Visits, registrations, paid referrals and revenue are for the selected period. Balances come from the referral wallet ledger and show the current total.
admin.enabledOn: Enabled — new referral relationships are created
admin.typesHint: Client order value, manual memberships, Legacy invites and bid-credit packages never earn commission.
admin.discountEnabled: Give referred users a one-time discount on their first eligible purchase
admin.confirmBody: This setting applies to new referrals only. Referrals registered earlier will continue under the policy that was in effect when they registered.
admin.confirmEnable: This turns the referral program on. New referrals will create real commission obligations.
admin.historyHint: Versions are immutable. Each referral keeps the version that was active when it registered.

reviewBody.approve: Approval confirms the request. Money is sent outside the platform; mark it paid after the transfer.
reviewBody.reject: Rejecting returns the reserved amount to the user's available balance.
reviewBody.paid: Record the transfer reference. This can be done only once.
